chunks.text: Today we will talk about South Korea.
South Korea is a modern and exciting country in East Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is South Korea?
South Korea is in East Asia.
It is next to North Korea and close to China and Japan.
It is on the Korean Peninsula and it is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
What is the capital city of South Korea?
The capital city is Seoul.
Seoul is a large, busy and high -tech city.
It has skyscrapers, temples, palaces and markets.
Other cities include Busan, a coastal city with beaches, Incheon, near Seoul with a big airport, Daegu and Gwangju, modern cities with culture and history.
How many people live in South Korea?
About 52 million people live in South Korea.
More than half of them live in or near Seoul.
South Korea is a developed country with fast internet, good public transport and modern life.
What language do people speak in South Korea?
People speak Korean.
Korean uses a writing system called Hangul.
It has 24 letters and it is simple to learn.
Many young people also speak some English, especially in cities and schools.
What is the weather like in South Korea?
South Korea has four seasons.
Spring, warm and full of flowers, summer, hot and rainy, autumn, cool and dry with colorful trees, winter, cold and snowy in the north.
People enjoy cherry blossoms in spring and autumn leaves in fall.
What does South Korea look like?
South Korea has mountains and hills, forests and temples, cities and villages, rivers, islands and the sea.
The land is green and beautiful, especially in spring and autumn.
What animals live in South Korea?
Some wild animals in South Korea are deer boars, foxes, squirrels and raccoon dogs, birds, frogs and butterflies.
People also love dogs, cats and other pets.
What do people eat in South Korea?
Korean food is fresh, spicy and healthy.

People eat rice, vegetables and meat, fish and seafood, kimchi, spicy fermented cabbage, very common, popular dishes, bibimbap, rice with vegetables, meat and egg, bulgogi, marinated beef, tiobaki, spicy rice cakes, samgyupsal, grilled pork at the table, ramyun, Korean style instant noodles.
Koreans often eat many side dishes with each meal.
What do people drink in South Korea?
People drink water, barley tea or corn tea, coffee, very popular in cafes, juices and milk drinks.
Adults may drink soju or makgyeoli, Korean alcohol.
What is life like in South Korea?
Life in South Korea is often fast, busy and organized.
People study hard and work hard.
Many people live in apartments and cities.
There are many shops, cafes, subways and parks.
People enjoy watching dramas and movies, listening to K -pop music, going to cafes and restaurants, shopping, hiking and gaming.
What are some holidays and traditions in South Korea?
Solal Korean New Year Lunar Calendar, Chuseok Korean Harvest Festival like Thanksgiving, Children's Day, May 5th, Independence Day, August 15th, Christmas also celebrated by many people.
People wear Hanbok, traditional clothes during special holidays.
Families eat together and honor their ancestors.
Some fun facts about South Korea.
The Korean alphabet hunger was created in the 1400s.
K -pop like BTS and Blackpink is famous around the world.
South Korea has fastest internet in the world.
The flag is white with a red and blue circle and four black symbols.
South Korea is known for technology, education and beauty products.
Now you know many things about South Korea.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the cities, weather, culture and daily life.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
